definitions.explanation: A roll forward on a mat, tucking the head and going over onto the back and up to the feet again. One of the first moves taught in school gymnastics; the backward roll is {後転|こうてん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{前転|ぜんてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To do a forward roll on the mat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{前転|ぜんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: We learned forward rolls in PE class.

examples.japanese: {前転|ぜんてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{後転|こうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can do a forward roll, but I still can't do a backward roll well.

notes:
The school-gymnastics term. Children at play call the same move ⟦でんぐり{返|がえ}し→でんぐり返し：33365_dengurigaeshi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前転|ぜんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {前転|ぜんてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do a forward roll
- {開脚前転|かいきゃくぜんてん}: a forward roll finishing with the legs apart
- {前転|ぜんてん}{跳|と}び: a handspring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後転|こうてん}: backward roll
- ⟦{宙返|ちゅうがえ}り→宙返り：33503_chuugaeri⟧: a somersault in the air, without touching the ground
